Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard is the human Supreme Marshall of the Flaming Fist and the father of  Wyll. His story stretches through all three acts of Baldur's Gate 3, and he can become a Camp Follower late in the game.

Ulder Ravengard is a recurring character in the Forgotten Realms setting of Dungeons and Dragons, appearing in the 5e adventures:  Murder in Baldur's Gate,  The Rise of Tiamat, and  Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus.

“
Courage. Insight. Strategy. Justice. Let these be the lights that guide you, my son.
„
— Ulder Ravengard, reciting his mantra to Wyll

Involvement

Act One

Ulder Ravengard is mentioned first during the quest ⁠Rescue the Grand Duke, upon arriving at Waukeen's Rest. He is suspected to be trapped inside the burning inn, but after rescuing  Counsellor Florrick, she reveals that the Grand Duke has been kidnapped.

Act Two

The party can learn he was taken to Moonrise Towers by the followers of the Absolute. In the Mind Flayer Colony underneath the Moonrise Towers there is an encounter with the Chosen Three -  Ketheric Thorm,  Orin the Red, and  Enver Gortash along with Ulder Ravengard. The Three infect Ravengard with a mind flayer tadpole and then whisk him away to Baldur's Gate.

Act Three

Wyrm's Rock Fortress

Upon entering Wyrm's Rock Fortress to attend Gortash's coronation, Ravengard is there in the Audience Chamber and officiates Gortash's swearing in as Archduke of Baldur's Gate. Immediately after the ceremony, Ravengard can be spoken with. If stating Florrick sent the party, he replies that she is a black widow who betrayed the city, and was punished. Choosing to connect with Ravengard's parasite for information about Florrick reveals that she is imprisoned in Wyrm's Rock Prison and set to be executed, starting ⁠Free Counselor Florrick. Prodding Ravengard's mind further reveals his deep uncertainty and fear of an illithid invasion, indicating his mind has not yet been fully subjugated.

Once the coronation is complete,  Mizora appears and reveals that Duke Ravengard was already moved to another location to be disposed of. She refuses to elaborate further and tells the party to go to camp. After a Long Rest, Mizora appears before Wyll to present a new contract - an eternity of servitude for Zariel in exchange for rescuing the Duke. If Wyll signs the contract, she reveals that Duke Ravengard is in Gortash's underwater prison, the Iron Throne, and promises to keep him from harm. Otherwise, if Wyll breaks the contract, Mizora states that Duke Ravenguard is as good as dead, and she plans to stick around to see what happens.

If ignoring the coronation and moving to the Lower City, Duke Ravengard remains in the Audience Hall with Gortash until the ceremony is completed. If completing the ⁠Disable the Steel Watch without attending the coronation, the entirety of Wyrm's Rock Fortress becomes hostile, including Duke Ravengard. Clearing the Iron Throne before the coronation causes the coronation attendants to become hostile, even if the Steel Watch is not fully disabled.

To ensure the Duke can be rescued and found in his intended location, it is advisable to attend the coronation, speak to Mizora, and then take a long rest.

The Iron Throne

See also: Iron Throne

After the previous events, Duke Ravengard is moved to the Iron Throne, dead or alive. The party can find the Iron Throne by exploring the Lower City, or being led there as part of the quests ⁠Disable the Steel Watch, ⁠Save the Gondians, ⁠Avenge the Ironhands, or ⁠Avenge the Drowned.

Duke Ravengard is in the block of cells directly east from the ladder to the submersible. He is in the middle cell with only 35 current HP if alive. He also has the  Fiendish Obeisance status, unless Wyll is not recruited to the party. Upon opening the door to his cell, the Duke becomes an Attached Follower. If Wyll broke his pact with Mizora, she appears and attempts to kill the Duke: once he leaves the cell, she gives him the  Fiendish Obeisance: Kneel status for one turn, preventing him from moving and giving him Disadvantage on Dexterity saves, and summons multiple  Combustion Belly Spiderlings next to the Duke which self-destruct using  Spiderling Burst on their turn or when killed. The Duke can be helped to survive or avoid the spiders by a variety of means including healing, granting protective effects such as Fire Resistance through  Protection from Energy: Fire or throwing an  Elixir of Fire Resistance near him,  Shield of Thralls,  Invisibility,  Sanctuary (though this doesn't protect against  Spiderling Burst) or helping him escape quicker with mobility spells such as  Haste,  Dimension Door,  Arcane Gate or  Omeluum's unique ability  Teleport to Submersible (Omeluum can be found here only as part of ⁠Retrieve Omeluum).

If Mizora and her witnesses  Cirrus and  Feena are not first spoken with at camp, the Duke is found dead. After escaping the Iron Throne, the party can make a deal with Mizora to resurrect the duke in exchange for renewing Wyll's pact, or reject the deal in order to break it. The availability of this option depends on Wyll's status and earlier choices.

If saved, Duke Ravengard stays at camp under the protection of the  Astral Prism. If Wyll is recruited to the active party, the pair can reconcile, and Ravengard asks the party to seek out  Ansur, Baldur's Gate's guardian dragon who sleeps under the city. If  Wyll is killed (e.g., as a result of an altercation with  Karlach during Act One), this detail is NOT shared with Ravengard when sharing the player character's memory via  The Emperor.

Speak with Dead

The questions below highly depend on the current situation.

  • How did the Absolute's cult capture you?
    • Duke Ulder Ravengard
      Attack on Waukeen's Rest... dragged to Moonrise...
      • Why were you at Waukeen's Rest?
        • Duke Ulder Ravengard
          Return to Baldur's Gate... awaken the wyrm... drive the Absolute from the city...
  • Is there any way to defeat the Absolute?
    • Duke Ulder Ravengard
      Awaken the wyrm... drive the Absolute from the city...
      • Awaken the wyrm? What wyrm do you mean?
        • Duke Ulder Ravengard
          Under the city... draconic protector...
  • How do I find the wyrm beneath the city?
    • Duke Ulder Ravengard
      Hidden entrance... Wyrm's Rock Prison... spark the torches...
  • Where can I find Counsellor Florrick?
    • Duke Ulder Ravengard
      Wyrm's Rock Prison... awaiting execution...
  • Where can I find the elder brain?
    • Duke Ulder Ravengard
      The Morphic Pool... beneath Baldur's Gate...
  • How do I get to the Morphic Pool?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • Wyll
    Father. Can you ever forgive me? (Wyll Origin only)
    • Narrator
      *The Grand Duke's corpse is silent. Perhaps it can't offer forgiveness. Perhaps it won't.*

Notes

  • Datamining suggests that there was a point in development when Ulder Ravengard could be rescued during Act Two. See Dialogs/Act2/Haven/HAV_Ravengard and Dialogs/Act2/MoonriseTowers/HAV_Minthara
  • Attacking Ulder Ravenguard at any point causes Wyll to turn against the party.
  • Ravengard can be killed and his Longsword, Armour and the The Legend of Ansur can be looted from his corpse after the duke's release from the Iron Throne without making Wyll or the camp hostile under certain circumstances. Killing him through exposure to Sapping Curse (Condition) from Victoria is not considered an attack by the player character.
